workspace.text:
Hi Brad. I've checked Priya Raman and Marcus Hale's calendars. Their overlapping free times (for a 30-min meeting) are:

- Monday: 9:00-10:00
- Tuesday: 13:00-14:00, 16:30-17:00
- Wednesday: 15:00-16:00
- Thursday: 10:00-10:30
- Friday: 11:00-12:00

Could you check Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars and let me know which of these slots work for both of them? Please prioritize the earlier/larger slots if multiple work.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Hi Alison. I've checked Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars. Unfortunately, none of the slots you proposed work for both Elena and David. Here's the breakdown:

- Monday 9:00-10:00: Both Elena and David are busy (Elena: Contract review + Recruiting call; David: Quarterly planning + Recruiting call)
- Tuesday 13:00-14:00: Both busy (Elena: Quarterly planning + Contract review; David: Client call + Busy)
- Tuesday 16:30-17:00: Both busy (Elena: Hiring panel; David: Travel)
- Wednesday 15:00-16:00: David busy entire slot (Partner lunch + Busy)
- Thursday 10:00-10:30: Elena busy (Hiring panel)
- Friday 11:00-12:00: Both busy (Elena: Client dinner prep + 1:1; David: Training session + Litigation strategy)

However, here are the overlapping free times for Elena and David:
- Monday: 11:00-12:00
- Tuesday: 09:00-10:00
- Wednesday: 13:00-14:00
- Thursday: 09:30-10:00, 14:30-15:30
- Friday: 15:00-16:00

Could you check if Priya and Marcus are free during any of these slots?
